---
params:
  area_code: "E92000001"
  area_name: "England"
  page_title: "title"
  data_name: "health_trends_data.rds"

title: "`r params$page_title`"

format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    fig-height: 3
    fig-format: svg
    filters:
      - inline-svg
    embed-resources: true
    css: www/styles.css
    lang: en
    anchor-sections: false
      
template: www/HTS.template

execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

area_code <- params$area_code
area_name <- params$area_name

# Read in data file from the output folder (output_path in the config)
file_path <- healthtrends:::get_data_path(params$data_name)

all_data <- readr::read_rds(file_path)

# get df of spotlight indicators, topic names, sex
# and check if multiple tiles are needed
spotlight_df <- healthtrends:::get_spotlight_df(
  all_data = all_data,
  area_code = area_code,
  spotlight = "first"
)

```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# title with dropdown

# get all area names, ordered England > Region > UTLA
# (alphabetical within each tier), matching the AreaCode geography prefixes
# used elsewhere in the package
all_area_names <- all_data |>
  dplyr::distinct(AreaCode, AreaName) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    area_rank = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_sub(AreaCode, 1, 3) == "E92" ~ 1L, # England
      stringr::str_sub(AreaCode, 1, 3) == "E12" ~ 2L, # Region
      TRUE ~ 3L                                       # UTLA
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(area_rank, AreaName) |>
  dplyr::pull(AreaName)

healthtrends:::html_title_dropdown(area_name, all_area_names)
```


```{r}
#| label: intro
#| results: asis
cat(
  paste0(
    '<p class="lead">Health trends in England presents information about the health of people in England and how it has changed over time. Topics presented include risk factors, disease prevalence and outcomes. Find out more ',
    '<a href ="',
    base_url <- config::get(
      value = "base_url",
      config = "production"
    ),
    'about.html">about Health trends in England</a>.</p>',
    '<p class="lead">This overview page presents a headline indicator for each topic. Click through to see more detailed information on each topic.</p>'
  )
)
```

for (i in seq_along(spotlight_df$IndicatorID)) {
  output <- c(
    output,
    knitr::knit_child("healthtrendsfiles/Quarto_extracts/_summary_tile.qmd")
  )
}
